metadata.description: Partial checklist for remaining properties batch 7 (EVM invalid opcode, EIP-3855 PUSH0, EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT, EIP-4844 BLOBHASH, EIP-1153 transient storage)

checklist.title: Verify undefined opcodes terminate execution with ErrInvalidOpCode and no exploitable behavior
detection_procedure: 1. Locate opcode dispatch in core/vm/interpreter.go Run() function
2. Examine jump table lookup for undefined opcodes (instruction_table.go)
3. Verify that undefined opcodes return nil operation, triggering error
4. Check ErrInvalidOpCode is returned for undefined opcodes in errors.go
5. Verify no partial state changes occur before error return
6. Test execution with undefined opcodes (0xFE, unassigned ranges)
7. Confirm gas is consumed appropriately even for invalid opcodes
8. Verify error is propagated correctly through call stack

executable_checks.assertion: Nil operation check for undefined opcodes

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-STATE-EVM-INVALID-OPCODE-001 -> State STATE-EVM-INVALID-OPCODE. Undefined opcodes must terminate cleanly without side effects. ErrInvalidOpCode terminates execution safely.

checklist.title: Verify PUSH0 opcode (0x5f) is only active on Shanghai+ forks and enters via normal EVM dispatch
detection_procedure: 1. Locate PUSH0 opcode definition in core/vm/opcodes.go (opcode 0x5f)
2. Verify jump table activation in instruction_table.go for Shanghai+
3. Check that PUSH0 is not present in pre-Shanghai jump tables
4. Confirm opcode 0x5f returns ErrInvalidOpCode on pre-Shanghai chains
5. Verify fork detection uses correct block number/timestamp
6. Test PUSH0 execution on Shanghai-activated testnet
7. Verify PUSH0 is dispatched through normal interpreter loop

executable_checks.assertion: PUSH0 implementation and fork gating exist

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP3855-NODE-STATE-PUSH0-OPCODE-START-001 -> State STATE-PUSH0-OPCODE-START. EIP-3855 PUSH0 opcode (0x5f) pushes constant zero. Shanghai+ fork activation required.

checklist.title: Verify PUSH0 charges exactly 2 gas (GasQuickStep) before stack push
detection_procedure: 1. Locate PUSH0 gas cost in core/vm/gas_table.go or jump_table.go
2. Verify constant gas is set to GasQuickStep (2)
3. Check gas deduction occurs before stack modification
4. Verify out-of-gas terminates execution without stack push
5. Confirm gas table entry: {execute: opPush0, constantGas: GasQuickStep}
6. Test PUSH0 with exactly 2 gas, 1 gas, and 0 gas
7. Verify gas refund handling if applicable

executable_checks.assertion: PUSH0 gas cost is defined as GasQuickStep (2)

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP3855-NODE-ACTION-PUSH0-CHARGE-GAS-001 -> Action ACTION-PUSH0-CHARGE-GAS. Gas cost: 2 (GasQuickStep). Gas exhaustion terminates execution cleanly.

checklist.title: Verify PUSH0 pushes exactly zero onto stack with stack overflow protection
detection_procedure: 1. Locate opPush0 implementation in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify push value is exactly zero (uint256.Int{})
3. Check stack depth limit enforcement (1024 items max)
4. Verify stack overflow returns appropriate error
5. Confirm no other values can be pushed by PUSH0
6. Check scope.Stack.push() implementation in core/vm/stack.go
7. Test PUSH0 at stack depth 1023 and 1024
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP3855-NODE-ACTION-PUSH0-PUSH-VALUE-001 -> Action ACTION-PUSH0-PUSH-VALUE. Pushes exactly zero. Stack depth bounded by 1024 limit.

checklist.title: Verify PUSH0 completion increments PC by 1 and returns to execution loop
detection_procedure: 1. Verify PUSH0 is single-byte opcode (no immediate data)
2. Check PC increment in interpreter loop after opcode execution
3. Verify opPush0 does not modify PC directly (interpreter handles it)
4. Confirm execution continues normally after PUSH0
5. Test PUSH0 followed by other opcodes
6. Verify no extra bytes consumed after PUSH0

executable_checks.assertion: PC increment happens in interpreter loop

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP3855-NODE-STATE-PUSH0-COMPLETE-001 -> State STATE-PUSH0-COMPLETE. Single-byte opcode, PC increments by 1. Normal execution loop continues.

checklist.title: Verify gas charging is first step in PUSH0 execution before any stack modification
detection_procedure: 1. Trace PUSH0 execution in core/vm/interpreter.go
2. Verify gas check occurs before operation execution
3. Locate gas deduction in interpreter Run() loop
4. Confirm gas underflow prevents opcode execution
5. Verify ErrOutOfGas is returned before stack is modified
6. Check all gas paths use consistent gas-first model

executable_checks.assertion: Gas deduction occurs before opcode execution

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP3855-EDGE-PUSH0-GAS-001 -> Edge EDGE-PUSH0-GAS. Gas-first execution model. No state changes if gas unavailable.

checklist.title: Verify value push only occurs after successful gas deduction
detection_procedure: 1. Verify gas deduction completes before opPush0 executes
2. Check interpreter loop structure enforces gas-then-execute
3. Confirm opPush0 cannot be reached without sufficient gas
4. Test boundary case: exactly 2 gas available
5. Verify atomicity of gas deduction and stack push
6. Check no partial execution on gas exhaustion
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP3855-EDGE-PUSH0-PUSH-001 -> Edge EDGE-PUSH0-PUSH. Transition from gas charging to value push requires successful gas deduction.

checklist.title: Verify PUSH0 completion returns to main EVM loop in correct state
detection_procedure: 1. Verify opPush0 returns nil error on success
2. Check interpreter loop continues on nil error return
3. Verify stack has exactly one new zero element
4. Confirm PC will be incremented on next loop iteration
5. Test multiple PUSH0 operations in sequence
6. Verify no state corruption on completion
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP3855-EDGE-PUSH0-DONE-001 -> Edge EDGE-PUSH0-DONE. Normal completion path returns to interpreter loop. PC advances to next instruction.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-6780 restricts SELFDESTRUCT to only destroy contracts created in same transaction
detection_procedure: 1. Locate SELFDESTRUCT implementation in core/vm/instructions.go (opSelfdestruct)
2. Verify Cancun+ fork check for EIP-6780 behavior
3. Check StateDB.Created() is called to verify same-transaction creation
4. Verify pre-existing contracts only transfer balance, not destroyed
5. Test SELFDESTRUCT on contract created in prior transaction (post-Cancun)
6. Verify contract code and storage remain after balance-only SELFDESTRUCT
7. Test SELFDESTRUCT on contract created in same transaction
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-NODE-STATE-SELFDESTRUCT-START-001 -> State STATE-SELFDESTRUCT-START. EIP-6780 behavior change (Cancun+). Destruction only for same-tx creation.

checklist.title: Verify same-transaction creation check uses StateDB.Created flag correctly
detection_procedure: 1. Locate StateDB.Created() in core/state/statedb.go
2. Verify Created flag is set during CREATE/CREATE2 operations
3. Check flag is transaction-scoped (cleared on tx end)
4. Verify SELFDESTRUCT checks this flag correctly
5. Test edge cases: nested creates, reverted creates
6. Verify flag cannot be manipulated by contract code
7. Check journal handling for Created flag on revert
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-NODE-ACTION-SD-CHECK-SAME-TX-001 -> Action ACTION-SD-CHECK-SAME-TX. StateDB tracks creation within transaction. Check is based on Created flag.

checklist.title: Verify SELFDESTRUCT balance transfer occurs atomically to correct beneficiary
detection_procedure: 1. Locate balance transfer in opSelfdestruct implementation
2. Verify beneficiary address is read from stack top correctly
3. Check SubBalance and AddBalance are atomic
4. Verify self-destruct to self case handling
5. Test beneficiary = caller, beneficiary = other, beneficiary = self
6. Verify no integer overflow/underflow in balance operations
7. Check journal entries for balance changes
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-NODE-ACTION-SD-TRANSFER-BALANCE-001 -> Action ACTION-SD-TRANSFER-BALANCE. Balance transfer occurs regardless of same-tx status. Beneficiary from stack top.

checklist.title: Verify destruction marking only occurs for same-transaction created contracts
detection_procedure: 1. Verify Destruct/SelfDestruct call is conditional on same-tx check
2. Check StateDB.selfDestructed set is only modified when appropriate
3. Verify code and storage are cleared at transaction finalization
4. Test that non-same-tx contracts are NOT marked for destruction
5. Verify destruction is applied in Finalise() or Commit()
6. Check clearDestructed() implementation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-NODE-ACTION-SD-MARK-DESTRUCTED-001 -> Action ACTION-SD-MARK-DESTRUCTED. Only reached when same-tx check passes. StateDB.Destruct() called.

checklist.title: Verify post-Cancun SELFDESTRUCT on pre-existing contracts only transfers balance
detection_procedure: 1. Test SELFDESTRUCT on contract created in prior transaction (post-Cancun)
2. Verify contract balance is transferred to beneficiary
3. Verify contract code remains after SELFDESTRUCT
4. Verify contract storage remains after SELFDESTRUCT
5. Verify contract can still be called after SELFDESTRUCT
6. Check no StateDB.Destruct() call on this path
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-NODE-STATE-SD-BALANCE-ONLY-001 -> State STATE-SD-BALANCE-ONLY. Post-Cancun: only balance transferred. Contract code and storage remain intact.

checklist.title: Verify full contract destruction occurs only for same-transaction created contracts
detection_procedure: 1. Test SELFDESTRUCT on contract created in same transaction
2. Verify contract code is cleared after transaction finalization
3. Verify contract storage is deleted
4. Verify balance is transferred to beneficiary
5. Verify contract cannot be called after finalization
6. Check StateDB.Finalise() handles destruction correctly
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-NODE-STATE-SD-FULL-DESTRUCT-001 -> State STATE-SD-FULL-DESTRUCT. Only reached via same-tx path. Full cleanup at finalization: code cleared, storage deleted.

checklist.title: Verify SELFDESTRUCT terminates current call frame execution
detection_procedure: 1. Verify opSelfdestruct returns error or stop signal
2. Check execution does not continue after SELFDESTRUCT
3. Verify control returns to caller (if nested call)
4. Test SELFDESTRUCT followed by other opcodes (should not execute)
5. Verify return value handling for SELFDESTRUCT
6. Check errStopToken or similar termination mechanism
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-NODE-STATE-SD-COMPLETE-001 -> State STATE-SD-COMPLETE. SELFDESTRUCT is terminating opcode. Similar to STOP, terminates call frame execution.

checklist.title: Verify all SELFDESTRUCT graph edges enforce deterministic same-transaction check
detection_procedure: 1. Trace all paths through SELFDESTRUCT implementation
2. Verify same-tx check branch is deterministic
3. Check no race conditions in creation flag access
4. Verify edge selection cannot be influenced by contract
5. Test all 7 edges: SD-CHECK-SAME-TX, SD-SAME-TX-YES, SD-SAME-TX-NO, SD-TRANSFER-ONLY, SD-DESTRUCT, SD-COMPLETE
6. Verify no path allows destruction without same-tx verification
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP6780-EDGES-001 -> Graph GRAPH-EIP-6780-SELFDESTRUCT. All 7 edges enforce EIP-6780 same-transaction check. Path selection is deterministic.

checklist.title: Verify BLOBHASH opcode (0x49) only returns hashes from current transaction's blobs
detection_procedure: 1. Locate BLOBHASH implementation in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify blob hashes are sourced from EVM TxContext
3. Check TxContext.BlobHashes is set from current transaction only
4. Verify no access to other transactions' blob hashes
5. Test BLOBHASH during blob transaction execution
6. Verify BLOBHASH returns zero for non-blob transactions
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP4844-NODE-STATE-BLOBHASH-START-001 -> State STATE-BLOBHASH-OPCODE-START. EIP-4844 proto-danksharding. Returns versioned hash from current tx's blobs.

checklist.title: Verify BLOBHASH graph implements secure bounds checking returning zero for invalid indices
detection_procedure: 1. Verify index is popped from stack correctly
2. Check bounds validation: index < len(blobHashes)
3. Verify out-of-bounds returns zero, not error
4. Test with index = 0, len-1, len, MaxUint256
5. Verify no panic on out-of-bounds access
6. Check gas charging occurs before index validation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP4844-NODES-001 -> Graph GRAPH-EIP-4844-BLOBHASH. 7 nodes implement secure blob hash retrieval. Bounds check returns zero for invalid indices.

checklist.title: Verify all BLOBHASH edges enforce gas charging and bounds checking
detection_procedure: 1. Trace all 7 edges through BLOBHASH implementation
2. Verify EDGE-BLOBHASH-GAS charges before execution
3. Verify EDGE-BLOBHASH-CHECK performs bounds validation
4. Check EDGE-BLOBHASH-OOB leads to zero return
5. Verify EDGE-BLOBHASH-VALID retrieves correct hash
6. Confirm no path bypasses gas or bounds check

executable_checks.assertion: BLOBHASH implementation with proper control flow

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP4844-EDGES-001 -> Graph GRAPH-EIP-4844-BLOBHASH. 7 edges enforce gas (GasVeryLow=3) and bounds checking. OOB returns zero, not error.

checklist.title: Verify transient storage is cleared after each transaction completion
detection_procedure: 1. Locate TSTORE/TLOAD in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify transient storage uses StateDB.transientStorage map
3. Check transientStorage is cleared in Finalise() or per-tx cleanup
4. Verify no persistence across transaction boundaries
5. Test TSTORE in tx1, TLOAD in tx2 (should return zero)
6. Verify transient storage does not affect state root
7. Check journaling for transient storage on revert
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EIP1153-NODES-001 -> Graph GRAPH-EIP-1153-TRANSIENT-STORAGE. EIP-1153 transient storage (Cancun+). 12 nodes. Data cleared per-transaction.
